items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: My oldest sister, my oldest sister, Dr. Brun, which was one of the most Philippine, that's Philippine Britannia.

ctx.x: You worked your way. Didn't you work for your music lessons?

Yeah, well after I made my first communion I had made an oath that my mother and father would never have to buy me nothing. And I worked after school. I worked like all that area from Jackson, all over to Louisiana Avenue, and on the other side of St. Charles. Them white people, my people knew. All of us did that.
